title: Fat Jason Is Real: GTA 6 Players Maxed Out His Weight 🍔 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 players maxed out Jason's weight within a day of launch, by feeding him burgers and tacos and skipping the gym. The result: a belly, puffy cheeks and a double chin, but, as GamesRadar put it, he's not very fat at all. Add workouts and you get "overweight strong" Jason. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told Dazed that food affects weight, exercise builds muscle and an in-game health app tracks sleep, diet and weight.

Fat Jason or ripped Jason? Comment below!

Sources: GamesRadar+, Notebookcheck (player findings, Nov 19, 2026); Dazed interview with Rockstar North / Kotaku. Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.
